products.title: Apartments & Inflation Heavyweight Hoodies
products.body_html:
Apartments & Inflation is a visual receipt for living in New York. Rising numbers, shrinking space, rent hikes disguised as “upgrades”—this piece captures the quiet math every New Yorker does just to stay put. It’s not commentary from the outside; it’s lived experience stitched into fabric.

The hoodie is offered in two heavyweight options, both built to hold up through long winters, colder apartments, & nights spent questioning where the heat went. The 10 oz. heavyweight balances warmth with flexibility—substantial enough for everyday wear, easy to move in, & built for constant rotation. The 13.3 oz. super heavyweight turns the dial up; denser, more structured, & designed for maximum insulation when the city feels especially expensive.

This is comfort armor. Something solid to wear while everything else keeps climbing.

Details-

  • Black heavyweight hoodies; two weight options
  • 10 oz. classic heavyweight; 70% cotton / 30% recycled polyester; soft cotton-faced finish
  • 13.3 oz. super heavyweight; 60% cotton / 40% polyester; maximum weight & structure
  • Built for cold weather, wind exposure, & long-term wear

Apartments shrink.

Prices rise.

The hoodie stays heavy.

products.title: Bronx Bombers Heavyweight Hoodies
products.body_html:
Bronx Bombers condenses New York power into a single, loaded image. It’s a triple entendre born in the city: graffiti writers bombing trains, a baseball dynasty built on pressure, & bomber aircraft engineered for force & inevitability. Different worlds, same energy.

This hoodie feels right moving through the Bronx—cutting across Mott Haven, posted up near 161st Street, or heading north toward Riverdale as the temperature drops. The city moves fast, the wind cuts sharper, & the layers matter. This one holds its ground.

Offered in two heavyweight black hoodie options, both are built for real use, cold weather, & long-term wear. Same artwork. Same presence. Two different weights, depending on how much armor you want.

The 10 oz. heavyweight balances warmth with mobility—substantial without bulk; easy to move in; ideal for daily wear, layering, & long hours outside.

The 13.3 oz. super heavyweight leans fully into structure & protection—denser, warmer, & more substantial in hand; built for colder nights, wind-exposed blocks, & standing still on late platforms.

New York confidence; reinforced.

products.title: Layer Cake of NY Heavyweight Hoodies
products.body_html:
A heavyweight, classic plush hoodie delivering exceptional comfort with serious substance. Layer Cake of New York reveals the city in cross-section; iconic skyscrapers above, hidden systems & stories below; capturing the chaos, grit, humor, & resilience that define NYC.

From street-level life to underground hustle, pizza, subways, & unseen infrastructure, every layer is drawn from PJ’s personal experiences in the city. The embroidery is highly detailed & hand sewn locally in New York, with depth & texture that can’t be fully captured in photos; seeing it in person is striking.

Available in two weights:

Built for comfort, presence, & longevity; this is New York, layered & worn.

products.title: New York City Arteries Crop Hoody
products.body_html:
New York City Arteries was born underground on the Union Square L train platform, inspired by the subway map that once stretched across the wall like a living system. What started as daily observation became survival; those lines carried PJ through years of selling prints, sketching between trains, & building independence the only way New York teaches it.

The design reimagines the NYC subway system as a human heart. Trains become blood flow. Boroughs become chambers. Movement becomes life. It’s a visual reminder that this city doesn’t just move people; it keeps them alive.

On the cropped hoody, that energy shifts from underground to open air. The shorter silhouette feels light, confident, & intentional; balanced against the depth of the embroidery on the back. At 8 oz., the fabric has enough weight to hold its shape, yet stays breathable for changing weather & long walks without commitment to a jacket.

Worn in the spring at Coney Island, it makes perfect sense. Ocean air rolling in. Boardwalk planks underfoot. The noise of rides, the pause between seasons, the city finally exhaling after winter. The hoody keeps you warm without feeling closed in; easy to throw on, easy to live in, easy to trust.

A piece about motion, survival, & the quiet confidence that comes from knowing exactly where you came from; while still moving forward.

Details

  • 8 oz. midweight fleece
  • 60% cotton / 40% recycled polyester
  • Soft hand feel with a structured drape
  • Cropped silhouette designed for movement & ease
  • Breathable warmth ideal for spring days & coastal air

products.title: 20,0000 Leagues Under NYC Heavyweight Hoodies
products.body_html:
20,000 Leagues Under NYC opens inside a subway car mid-crossing; straphangers gripping poles, faces lit by flickering fluorescents, eyes fixed on the windows as a giant squid drifts alongside in the East River. Tentacles slide past the glass, suction cups thudding softly against steel, the tunnel suddenly feeling less like infrastructure and more like open water. Inspired by Jules Verne & the L train’s underwater passage, the artwork turns a routine commute into a deep-sea encounter; fear, wonder, & disbelief sharing the same car.

Offered in two heavyweight hoodie options, both are built for cold platforms, late nights, & long exposure to wind that feels like it’s coming off the river itself. Same concept. Same presence. Two levels of armor.

The 10 oz. heavyweight delivers warmth with flexibility—soft, wearable, & easy to move in. It’s substantial without feeling bulky; ideal for everyday rotation, layering, & hours spent waiting underground while the city flows above.

The 13.3 oz. super heavyweight is built for maximum protection. Denser, heavier, & more structured, it’s designed for colder conditions, longer waits, & standing still while everything else moves. Premium feel throughout; no shortcuts.

Both versions feature the same 20,000 Leagues Under NYC artwork—bold, immersive, & designed to last. This isn’t just a hoodie. It’s survival gear for imagined depths.
